comment:
* The "duplex" element indicates how the communication service send and receive media. It can
 * contain two elements: "supported" and "notsupported." The supported and
 * nonsupported elements can contains four elements: "full", "half", "receive-only" and
 * "send-only".

variables.name: ELEMENT_NAME
variables.comment: The name of the duplex element

variables.name: ELEMENT_SUPPORTED
variables.comment: The name of the supported element

variables.name: ELEMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED
variables.comment: The name of the notsupported element

variables.name: DUPLEX_FULL
variables.comment: The device can simultaneously send and receive media

variables.name: DUPLEX_HALF
variables.comment: The service can alternate between sending and receiving media.

variables.name: DUPLEX_RECEIVE_ONLY
variables.comment: The service can only receive media

variables.name: DUPLEX_SEND_ONLY
variables.comment: The service can only send media
